methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated addition of complex float arrays.

methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated addition of int16_t arrays.

methods.name: add_bbb_simd
methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated addition of int8_t arrays.
